attestation.explanation: The monitoring report is verified as belonging to this project, was registered by an accredited auditor, and is not copied from or overlapping with any other registered project. The claimed 250 tCO2e works out to about 2.53 tCO2e per hectare over 98.9 ha, which is within the plausible range for reforestation.
